analysis: Exploratory associations of trait anxiety and perceived social support with posterior alpha reactivity during resting-state EEG

band.selection_status: data-informed post hoc selection after same-cohort canonical-band exploration

band_selection_sensitivity.model: exact final posterior-ROI natural-spline specification applied independently to each band
band_selection_sensitivity.nonlinearity_multiplicity: separate Holm correction across 8 band-by-scale nonlinearity tests
band_selection_sensitivity.result: only alpha-MSPSS survives Holm-8; alpha-STAI and every non-alpha total test do not
band_selection_sensitivity.selective_inference_boundary: does not correct every analytical representation or functional form examined in the same cohort

spline.complexity_multiplicity: Holm across STAI and MSPSS separately within each nominal basis df

multiplicity.focused_alpha_primary: Holm separately across 2 total tests and 2 nonlinear tests
multiplicity.post_selection_four_band_context: Holm across 8 total tests and separately across 8 nonlinear tests
multiplicity.sensor_maps: BH-FDR across 61 electrodes separately within each map

topographic_analysis.absolute_alpha: 8-13 Hz density in dB re 1 uV2/Hz
topographic_analysis.relative_alpha: 100 * integrated 8-13 Hz power / integrated 1-45 Hz power
topographic_analysis.relative_reactivity: EC relative alpha minus EO relative alpha, percentage points
topographic_analysis.association_color: directional linear component from the adjusted natural-spline analysis
topographic_analysis.sensor_inference: BH-FDR across 61 total 3-df spline tests separately within each map
topographic_analysis.colormap: viridis for unsigned EO/EC power; RdBu_r for symmetric zero-centered signed maps
topographic_analysis.sensor_display: all 61 locations shown as small black dots; channel-name labels intentionally omitted
topographic_analysis.geometry: standard_1005 projected with the MNE eeglab sphere; one enclosing radius used identically for head outline and interpolation mask

data_sharing.public_release_candidate: excludes participant-level measurement rows and identifier-bearing leave-one-out output; exact preprocessing source retains three pseudonymous LEMON exclusion IDs

preprocessing_script.role: bad-channel detection, LOF advisory role, ICA/ICLabel rules, interpolation, and EEG exclusions

psd_script.role: window QC, density-scaled periodogram, frequency-bin edge rules, and band summaries

source_audit.role: aggregate source-audit counts and source provenance

canonical_cache_script.role: portable constructor of the 1-45 Hz and canonical-band inputs consumed by the analysis

upstream_source_specifications.execution_boundary: included for direct methods audit; not rerun by the final statistical-analysis stage

source_audit.sanitization: local source_project path replaced; aggregate counts unchanged
